title: File:Kru Phon Narupai with his twin and Kru Lop Narupai training in Thailand - Dec 2021.jpg
author: Dacuevas
description: Kru Phon Narupai (right) training alongside his twin brother Kru Lop Narupai (left) at a Muay Thai gym in Thailand. Both are legendary Muay Thai fighters and trainers from Thailand’s Golden Era. The photo was taken on December 7, 2021.
